content: Iesu Nazareth nan Sisisiweiai
Iesu on efan ikirir ato imatabir men inai an goa mafam aurin, On an baigibubunuotis mat On sigibubunuai sinai.

Sabat an rai On ibosuruf bayoi goai nan sabu ibibebeyes. Sabu sigaraba maiau nan On an dura si’tatam on engon siduduran. Osi sitetem siyau, “On atonio osi bobo engon on mamaba isagob? On min abi sagob gigiboan on sitai? On bobo buburis on mamaba efofour semamatar?
On min goa baigoyonotin, On min Mary Natun, a On taitain James, Joseph, Judas a Simon? Ai On rorobun min nin semama i?” On mes osi engon tutufin sisisiweiai.
Iesu iyawures iyau, “Aubairuruotin on menan menan enan on engon sekakafai ato Toun an mafam gagaminai bag On an dam warar a Toun an goa amonai on ambin.”
On mes On bobo buburis men fofonin nan itfouren on, ab On asir iman wat sabu sawauis fani ibotobonis ato siyayawas.

Iesu on totor men sunub iduduran yabin sabu asi baitutum on ambin. Iesu Baigibubunuotis Auyotoat Sasagis Ruam Iyafares Sigat (Matthew 10.5-15; Luke 9.1-6) Namon Iesu inai mafam goa amosi nan sabu ibibebeyes.
On baigibubunuotis auyotoat sasagis ruam iyores siruayo ato ruruam ruruam iyafares sigat. On faiwar ites ayu komasis sinfaitanis singat mes,
ato On dura wawaninai iyawures iyau, “Omi men sawar aifan tani wonboai ami bib amonai mes ab siwa wat on wonboai, omi men rafi sarar, men kukufet wonboai, men agim tani ami ara’ai wonikamabinen mes.
Omi amm kikiman on woniwanim, baise men usim an baitakwakwaren tani wonboai mes.”
Mat On iyawures iyau, “Omi wonan mafam gagaminai nan sabu sinbikakaiwim on nan goa kaitamom amonai wonama weie on mafam gagamin on wonikirir wonan.
Omi wonnat on efanai nan wongat ato sabu men sinbikakaiwim a ami dura men sintatam on, wonikirires ato ammui fofou wonrutataben sinsur ato wonan. Atonio bobo on iniyoboes osi on sibokomas!”
Ato osi sigat dura sibino sabu auris osi ya baikitabir sitboai mes.
Osi ayu komasis on sigaraba sifaitanis sigat ato olive an momonai nan sabu sigaraba simutes ato siyawas.
John Bapataito’otin Irabob

Aiwab Herod on atonio bobo engon simamatar on duran itatam yabin Iesu an dudur on irat tafanam engon ibonu. Sabu fani on si’yau, “John Bapataito’otin on iyawas men emama! On mes on atonio faiwar ibo ato osi bobo buburis efofour.”
Baise sabu fani on si’yau, “On on Elijah.” Sabu fani on si’yau, “On aubairuruotin tani, ainau bag aubairuruotis fani simama ba.”
Herod on dura itatam on iyau, “On on John Bapataito’otin! Yau on anjon asutin itutu baise on iyawas men emama!”
Herod toun dura wawanin iyau John fatumin aurin, ato on ann iman sifatumen fafatum goai sireberuai. Herod atonio bobo on Herodias fasinai on ifour, on toun tain tuan Philip awan on iyabaruai.
John Bapataito’otin on nana Herod i’yawur, “Om men ibasit taim tuam awan on utiawan!”
Herodias on igogoi bag John itasubun on mes on ibimagigirai baise Herod emon on mes men fofonin aifan itafour on.

Herod min John aurin ibeber yabin on isagob John on orot obin a kakafotin, on mes on obinai wat ikakaifarai. John an dura ra engon ibikakafun Herod itatam on ibinonotai kwakwan baise on nana igogoi an dura ittatam.
On gibunai Herodias an eta igaturai. Herod irarat ra aurin on an forag ibotitiwag on an gawan babadis ainauis auris, wou yangan asi babadis gagamis auris, a Galilee yangan asi babadis gagamis auris.
Herodias natun jeverei irui isau, Herod an sabu mat iyasisires. On mes aiwab orot jeverei aurin iyau, “Om aifan egogoi unboai? Om am gogoi sawar aifan aurin u’nau on arimon anitem.”
On an aumatan sigaraba auris on ifaro iyau, “Yau aumatanim om am gogoi aifan aurin u’nau on arimon engon tutufin anitem, mat fofonin au baiaiwab turin ankuseb anitem!”
Ato jeverei igat ayon itetemai iyau, “Dad yau abifan aurin on anifefeyanai i?” Ayon iyafotai iyau, “John Bapataito’otin unin.”
Ra kaita jeverei sasasan wat imatabir men irui aiwab orot iyawur iyau, “Yau ari bag agogoi John Bapataito’otin unin nin ramoai uniwan uniteu!”
Atonio dura iyamai aiwab orot on iyababan kwakwan baise on men fofonin jeverei aurin itifonaseir yabin on an baifaro on iyamen nono an sabu matasi.

On mes aiwab orot on ra kaita goa an kaifarotin iyafarai an dura fofoninai John Bapataito’otin unin itboai itmatabir men. Goa kaifarotin inai au fafatum goa, ato John Bapataito’otin anjon iyasutin itutu;
namon on ramoai iwan ibo imatabir men jeverei itai ato jeverei ibo ayon itai.
John an baigibubunuotis on bobo aifan imamatar on dura sitatam ato sinat John usin sibo sinai sigarob.
Iesu Sabu 5,000 Ibayues
Baiyoyobotis simatabir men Iesu sinefotai ato bobo mamaba sibobo a sabu sibibebeyes on engon tutufin sikasonai.

Sabu sigaraba maiau on si’nan si’nat ato Iesu an baigibubunuotis mat on wera men fofonin arimon bayu sitam on. On mes On iyawures iyau, “Ot ekesit wat tanan efan tani kifafanai nan ato omi kafakakai woniyarir.”
On mes osi sibosuruf ekesis mom wa sibo sinai efan kifafanai nan.

Baise sabu sigaraba maiau on osi sites on ra kaita sisagobis osi on iyabon, on mes osi sabu on mafam gagamis sigaraba emon sigat ababai siyayai mom sinai Iesu an baigibubunuotis mat sigiseires ato osi ainau sinat on efanai nan sigat.

Iesu wa emon igat mom, On atonio sabu kuayo gagamin ites on, On sabu auris nunuan iyababan yabin osi on foro sheep ba ato asi kaifarotin on ambin. On mes On ibosuruf bobo sigaraba auris on sabu ibebeyes.
Wera isusur ibosuruf ibirabirabi ato On an baigibubunuotis sinat ato siyau, “Wera isawar nono, ato nin on efan kifafan wat.
Sabu eiyafares sinan atonio auwatin nan masau guwiai a mafam gugudis nan osi tous asi bayu sintobonen sinam.”
Iesu iyafotes iyau, “Omi toum ami bayu on wonites sinam.” Osi sitetemai siyau, “Om egogoi wei wanan agim 200 kina nanaba wanreben rafi sarar wantobonen ato sabu wanibayues?”
Iesu itetemis iyau, “Omi wonai woit, rafi sarar biyam nanaba aurim sen?” Osi sigaturen ato siyawur siyau, “Rafi sarar on nim nanaba ato iyan on ruam mom.”
Namon Iesu an baigibubunuotis iyawures iyau, “Omi sabu wokusesebis matas matas nan wayoai sinmairirin.”
Ato sabu on an sanaf an sanaf nanaba simairirin, matas orot nim a matas orot ruam auyotoat nanaba.
Namon Iesu rafi sarar nim a iyan ruam iboen au safam itage ato God aurin ikakaiu. On rafi sarar iyabaseseben an baigibubunuotis ites ato sabu siraramis. Iyan ruam mat engon siraramis.
Sabu engon tutufin siyam siyakokor.
Namon On an baigibubunuotis kaifet siboen sarar a iyan tuturis sibiwanen on kaifet auyotoat sasagis ruam awas sibonuen.
Ato orot wat kuayo gagamin on 5,000 nanaba on sibayues.
Iesu Kamitai Ibib
Ra kaita Iesu an baigibubunuotis iyawures wayai sikaruge ato osi ekesis wat ainau sitan au Bethsaida nan kamit rebanai, weie On sabu kuayo gagamin itiyafares sitan mes.
On an baigibubunuotis iyau baitotoris si’nan gibunai On igai oyauai nan itbayoi mes.
Ibirabirabi an werai on baigibubunuotis asi wa on kamit basunai nan ato Iesu on ekesin mom motobai.

On iyeit an baigibubunuotis ites on wa siboboi wat on men fofonin yabin yabat on nasi emon isisin ato fomenei ra awan nanaba on Iesu kamit tefanai ibib inai auris. On kamit tefanai ibib i’nan itigiseires mes,
baise osi siyeit On sit on kamit tefanai ibib inan. Osi sinos on “Dau orot!” On mes osi siyoku.
Osi On sit on siber kwakwan. Ra kaita Iesu osi auris ikakafun iyau, “Omi nunuam sinwani! Nin on Yau, omi men wonaber mes!”
Namon On wayai ikaruge auris, ato yabat itutu. Baigibubunuotis on totor siduduran kwakwan,
yabin sabu 5,000 sibibayues an yabin bag on osi men sisagob a mat osi asi not on engon ifot.
Iesu on Sabu Sawauis Gennesaret nan Iyawasis
Osi kamit sirabon sinai au Gennesaret nan, ato asi wa siyous iyoyot.
Osi asi wa sibikirir mom on ra kaita sabu on Iesu sit sisagob.
On mes osi sabu on tafanam engon amonai siyayai sinai ato dura sitatam Iesu menan menan i’nan on osi sabu sawauis ireai si’yen auman siboes sinat aurin.

Ato Iesu efan menan nan i’nan au mafam goa, au mafam gagamis a masau guwiai nan sabu sawauotis siboes si’nan baitotobon efanai nan sibifefeyanai itibasites an beber rewan wat sitruyein. Ato osi Iesu an beber wat siruruyein on engon siyayawas.
